$comment: run() command classes (DESIGN-v2 §2.4, D3). Seed: fixtures/herdr-app-commands.json (herdr-app commands, Herdr app 0.1.13, 71 names).
Loaded and checked by packages/bridge/src/session/commands.ts: a name in two classes is an error; a name in none (and not a loaded mod's `<folder>.<command>`) is refused and logged.
session: applied to the device's own session (navigator, layout clicks, focus, overlays); never sent to the Mac. Herdr: 'Selection, focus, zoom and settled state belong to this screen only'.

structural: refused on devices with a toast; the value names the refusal text in `refusals`. Covers D3 structure plus commands that act on the Mac's own window, dialogs, clipboard or app lifecycle (DESIGN-v2 lists app.quit and window.* here).

passthrough: `herdr-app do <name> <json>` (E9), act scope only; `fill` lists optional arguments the session fills from its own focus so the command acts on what the device shows, not on the Mac's focus.
mod: dynamic, not listed: `<loaded mod folder>.<command>` delivers `<command>` to that folder's copies' nextCommand(); read scope refused.

session.layout.select: stack destination: session click; phone: switch in place or replace(route containing the stack)
session.layout.show: session click hidden:false; phone/tablet-portrait: push(route(id)) for a panel route
session.layout.hide: session click hidden:true; pops the panel's route
session.layout.resize: phone: no-op; tablet/desktop: the device's layout profile for a node it may resize (overridable(), size of its kind; D12), else a session size click
session.agent.focus: session focus (agent, its space/tab/pane); phone: navigate to the pane group route
session.agent.next: session focus: next agent in the mods' setAgentOrder order (model order without one)
session.pane.focus: session focus (pane, or the pane showing terminal); phone: navigate to the pane group route
session.pane.go: session focus: neighbour pane of the shown tab ([I] left/up = previous, right/down = next pane in tab order)
session.pane.zoom: phone: no-op; tablet/desktop: session zoom of the pane
session.space.select: session focus (space by index or id); phone: navigate to the pane group route
session.tab.select: session focus (tab by index in the shown space, or id); phone: navigate to the pane group route
session.tab.next: session focus: next tab of the shown space
session.tab.prev: session focus: previous tab of the shown space
session.terminal.peek: session peek sheet over the screen; nav pop closes it
session.mod.open: overlay opened on this device only (view manager)
session.overlay.close: overlay closed on this device only (view manager); the peek sheet first

refusals.structure: Structural change — use the Herdr window
refusals.mac-window: Acts on the Herdr window on the Mac — not available remotely
refusals.mac-app: Quits or updates Herdr on the Mac — use the Herdr window
